Iowa

  • Investment to date

    $20B+

    Google has invested more than $20 billion in Iowa since building our data center in Council Bluffs in 2007.

  • Established in Iowa

    2007

    We have called Iowa home since 2007.

  • Economic activity generated

    $2.7B

    In 2025, Google helped provide $2.7 billion of economic activity for thousands of Iowa businesses, nonprofits, publishers, creators, and developers.

  • Iowans trained on digital skills

    112K+

    Grow with Google has partnered with over 100 organizations in Iowa to train more than 112,000 Iowans on digital skills.

  • Supporting local initiatives

    $1.3M

    Google collaborated with the Great Outdoors Foundation and the Iowa Department of Agriculture and Land Stewardship to contribute $1.3 million to support a 47-site grade stabilization project to improve the quality of water flowing into the Missouri River, the Mississippi River, and the Gulf of Mexico — all of which are critical to vibrant communities across our nation.
